title: Double Wall Plug Socket 2 Gang 13A W  2 Charger USB  Outlets Flat Plate UK
body_html:
Features:

Made by fireproof PC material, high temperature resistant and safe to use.
Conductive carrier is used thick copper for good conductivity.
Easy to install and easy to use, power saving.
With UK plug so you can use it anywhere、anytime and easy to install.
Perfect for homes, offices and work places with a limited amount of wall plate.

Description:
This USB Wall plate provides two standard AC plug wall electrical outlet and 2 USB outlets for charging Cell Phones, Tablets, and USB devices etc.
AC plug design, effectively avoid danger of electric shock.

Specifications:
Material: PC, Copper
Color:  White
Voltage: AC100-250V 13A
USB output parameter: DC 5V/2.1A（max）
Size:146 x 86 x 36mm/ 86 x 86 mm

Each Package Included:
4 x Rechargeable Wall UK Socket Plate
8 x Screws
